title: جوج أنواع ديال البعاد
angle: Space that invites the partner back (calm, I'll be here when you're ready) vs the silent treatment that punishes. Name: السكات العقابي. Both sexes do it.

title: الخوف من الخسارة
source_topic: Day 78 - The Willingness to Lose Her
angle: The more you fear losing someone, the more you cling, the more you push them away. Neediness = التعلق المرضي. Secure love: I want you, but I'll be ok. Both sexes.

title: الميزان
source_topic: Day 72 - Invest Less Than She Does (reframe)
angle: Reframe as balance of investment: the one who gives everything alone burns out and gets taken for granted. Match effort, don't keep score.

title: شكون كيهدّن الآخر؟
angle: Couples where one always explodes and the other always calms. Learn to calm yourself first (تنظيم المشاعر). Calm is contagious, so is panic.

title: تحت الضغط
angle: When money/work stress hits, don't dump all fear on your partner; share it calmly, as a team. Panic spreads, steadiness spreads too.

title: الراحة قتلات الحب؟
angle: Too much comfort (pyjamas, phone, routine) kills spark; zero comfort kills safety. Need both: الأمان + شوية ديال الجديد.

title: شوية ديال التوتر مزيان؟
angle: Debate: a little playful tension (teasing, mystery) keeps attraction; real conflict destroys it. Difference between playful and hurtful.

title: سخون بارد
angle: Why a hot-cold partner hooks you: the brain gets addicted to uncertain rewards (like gambling, التعزيز المتقطع). Warning: that's not love, it's a trap. Both sexes.

title: بزاف ديال الميساجات
angle: Constant checking 'fin nta? 3lach ma jawbtich?' creates pressure. Texting to plan, presence to connect. Trust > tracking.

title: التحكم ماشي حب
source_topic: Day 87.5 - Control is the opposite of love
angle: Checking phone, choosing friends/clothes = control, not love. Both sexes do it. Love gives freedom + trust.

title: الضحك فالخصومة
angle: Defuse small silly fights with humour (agree and exaggerate) instead of defending. Not for serious issues.

title: البرودة فالخصومة
angle: Staying calm when the other shouts: don't match the volume. Breathe, lower your voice, answer later. Calm wins the argument.

title: المزيان بزاف
source_topic: The Nice Guy Is The Problem (reframe)
angle: Being 'too nice' = saying yes to avoid conflict, hidden resentment. Kind ≠ no limits. Applies to girls too ('the nice girl').

title: كتراقب راسك بزاف
angle: Over-thinking how you look/sound in front of your partner makes you stiff. Ease and being yourself is attractive.

title: قول «لا» وخليه حر
angle: A good partner can disagree honestly and still respect the other's choices. Not a yes-man, not a jailer.

title: الحب بلا قفص
angle: Love grows with freedom, dies in a cage. Jealousy/locking down pushes people out. Trust + own life + come back by choice.

title: الحياة فعينيك
angle: People are attracted to someone who loves their own life (hobbies, goals, energy), not someone whose whole life is the partner.

title: الاهتمام عملة
angle: Attention is the real currency of love; phones steal it. 10 minutes of full attention > 3 hours side by side on the phone.

title: كلشي ولا ساهل
angle: Apps, swiping, delivery: we expect love to be instant too and quit at the first difficulty. Real love is built, not ordered.

title: الجهة المظلمة ديالك
angle: Everyone has jealousy, anger, ego. Hiding it makes it explode; owning it ('I get jealous, help me') makes you stronger as a couple.

title: نصايح الرجال vs العيالات
angle: Funny contrast: what men tell men vs what women tell women about love; both extremes are wrong; the truth is in the middle. Debate, no hate.

title: حقائق على الفراق
angle: Hard truths for both: stalking the ex's stories keeps the wound open, rebound relationships, closure comes from you, time + no contact heals.

title: واش كلشي نرجسي؟
angle: Today every ex is a 'نرجسي'. Real narcissism vs normal bad behaviour; using the label to avoid looking at your own part. Debate.

title: علامات البعاد
angle: Signs a partner is drifting away (phone face-down, less sharing, irritation) — for both sexes; talk early instead of spying.

title: العلاقة من بعيد
angle: Brutal truths about long distance (Morocco/abroad couples): needs an end date, rituals, trust; video calls ≠ life together.

title: ما تبقاش تبرر
angle: Over-explaining and justifying every little thing in a fight looks guilty and drags it on. Say it once, clearly.

title: شنو حنا؟
angle: The 'situationship' pain: not knowing what you are. Uncertainty hurts more than a clear no. Ask the question.

title: الاحترام قبل الحب
angle: You can't stay attracted to someone you don't respect; contempt (الاحتقار) is the #1 predictor of divorce (Gottman).

title: كتقتل اللي جاب الخبر
angle: When your partner raises a problem, attacking them for saying it instead of hearing it. Criticism vs complaint.

title: واش ترجع للإكس؟
angle: Debate: going back to an ex — when it can work (both changed) vs when it's just loneliness. Both sexes.

title: الغيرة
angle: Why we suddenly want someone when others want them; jealousy as a signal vs jealousy as control.

title: اللعب فالعلاقة
angle: 'I don't play games' but everyone does: waiting to reply, making jealous. Small games vs manipulation.

title: كنبغيو اللي تعبنا عليه
angle: We love what we invest in (IKEA effect): couples who build things together (projects, trips) bond more. Both sexes.

title: السبب الأول ديال الفراق
source_topic: Most common reason for losing a woman (reframe)
angle: Effort stops after the 'yes'/wedding: no more dates, compliments, curiosity. What you did to get them, do it to keep them.

title: لغات الحب
angle: The 5 love languages (كلام، وقت، هدايا، مساعدة، لمسة): you love in your language, your partner hears another one.

title: كاين ولا لا؟
angle: Physically there but emotionally absent; signs of emotional unavailability; why some people choose unavailable partners.

title: الاختبارات
angle: Both partners test each other ('would you still...?'). Pass by being honest and steady, not by winning.

title: كيفاش تنتاقد بلا ما تجرح
angle: How to give criticism to your partner: about the action not the person, private not public, with a request.

title: حتى واحد ما كيشبع
angle: Hedonic adaptation (التعوّد): after a while the new becomes normal for EVERYONE; gratitude and novelty fight it.

title: نصايح صحابك
source_topic: Why women give bad dating advice (reframe)
angle: Friends' advice can wreck a couple: they hear one side, project their own story. Who to ask, what to keep private.

title: الملل
angle: Boredom creates fake problems in couples; new shared experiences (novelty) raise dopamine and closeness.

title: شكون خاصو يبادر؟
angle: Debate: in Morocco should only the man initiate (message, proposal)? Pros/cons; comments bait.

title: الوجه الأول
source_topic: Day 20.5 - Public face vs real self
angle: At the start you meet the 'public version'; the real person appears in stress, travel, money. Look for that early.

title: دخل لعالمو
angle: Curiosity about your partner's world (their work drama, hobbies) instead of fixing or changing topic. Empathy = التعاطف.

title: الهضرة ولات تحقيق
angle: Couple talk became a checklist ('klit? fin knti?'). Play, joke, share stories, not interrogate.

title: بغيه… بلا ما تذوب فيه
source_topic: Day 42.5 - Show desire without being consumed by it (84k)
angle: Show your partner you want them (compliments, time) without losing yourself: no own life, friends, goals = you melt into them and they stop seeing you. Both sexes.
